objective: 固定占地、保持 DRAM 有效供数和稳态计算吞吐的双 logic 层切分与物理反馈 RTL 优化

technology.process_scope: single-die open PDK plus explicitly assumed TSV/bonding proxy; not a 3D foundry PDK

stack.DRAM0_to_L0: F2F conceptual; existing DRAM anchors retained
stack.L0_to_L1: F2B: L0 backside lands on L1 frontside, TSVs through L0
stack.L1_to_package: L1 backside with host and power TSVs
stack.coordinate_view: all coordinates expressed in common top view; local front faces of L0/L1 both point upward

geometry.utility_assignment: clk/rst_n use first two utility sites of window 0; other 14 reserved, not functional capacity
geometry.host_pin_order: ascending port string from original 181-bit host interface
geometry.L0_blockages: original G1-20 union plus 3x3 TSV keepout at every link-grid site; no original host edge pins
geometry.L1_blockages: 3x3 keepout at all link-grid PG sites and 181 package-host TSVs; no copied DRAM blockers
geometry.single_controls_blockages: original G1-20 plus 181 package-host TSV keepouts; no logic-logic windows or extra TSVs
geometry.routing_policy: TSV KOZ blocks li1/met1/met2/met3; 2x2 met5 landing terminal with 0.5um surrounding clearance on met4/met5 except central legal access; ordinary die routing and PDN checked separately
geometry.allocation: reserve utility and PG first; order host functional ports then fold_x[0:31],fold_start,fold_consume, then moved lanes ascending, each forward bits then reverse bits; round-robin windows, row-major signal sites; never overlap terminals
geometry.package_pin_change: reassign host pads consistently to the frozen package strip for S0/Sarea and L1; historical physical numbers are not reused
geometry.TSV_row_policy: Snap TSV cell keepouts outward to core-origin site/row grid, cut affected rows BEFORE taps/endcaps/PDN; no tap/endcap exemptions inside new TSV KOZ. Existing MC auxiliary exceptions remain restricted to original rules. Report raw and row-snapped union separately.

timing.link_clock: common synchronous clock, propagated per-die CTS and package/root feedthrough
timing.link_encoding: unserialized parallel wires, one logical value per signal per cycle
timing.retiming_policy: P1/P2 may retime only if all identical-workload throughput gates still pass; no new clocks or serial PHY
timing.RLC_model: per vertical signal, pi RC: total C split half at each terminal; excludes local wires and library pin C
timing.RC_evidence: assumed sensitivity envelope, NOT extracted or claimed foundry-calibrated; applies equally across pitch scenarios
timing.STA: merge actual die netlists under L0/L1; hierarchical SPEF -path plus top-level link SPEF; propagated common clocks; remove die-local artificial IO budgets from final analysis; verify annotation/connectivity/units, setup and hold
timing.input_transition_reason: New common fixture uses 1ns instead of historical 2ns: chosen endpoint cell input max_transition is 1.5ns; all references rerun under new fixture.

RC_sanity_geometry.source_kind: assumed engineering sanity model; not a calibrated field solver

implementation_only_cross_die_io_budget_.scope: per-die optimization only, removed in final stitched STA; not an acceptance shortcut

P0.name: compute-only coarse cut
P0.equivalence_expectation: same cycle-level behavior before physical delays; L0->L1->L0 combinational paths require joint STA

eligible_changes: move corresponding weight-row lane storage/valid state with reservation proof
regroup control/buffering without reducing useful capacity
retime only with full throughput proof
fixed_resources: host-facing command/config and output order stay L0; 181 host feedthrough wires fixed for this pilot
feedback.target_selection: 100um fixed bins; top 3 by DRC count then coordinates from latest completed snapshot; report new hotspots and die totals
feedback.best_selection: function/performance first; complete route then fewer unrouted nets then total D10 then total CPU; earliest candidate breaks ties

verification.functional: reuse original verifier arithmetic/config/ordering/late-error assertions; separate new metrics harness; never relax original correctness assertions
tests: independent request stalls and response delays
reset with outstanding responses then fresh job
output stall and both output banks busy
capacity-limited case must reject infeasible cut
link SPEF units, hierarchy, short/open and no duplicate C
min/max RC, L0->L1 and L0->L1->L0 timing paths

response_profiles.jitter: per-lane ordered due cycles, latency uniform integers 1..7; request ready=0 on exactly 1 in 4 PRNG draws; at most 1 return/lane/cycle
response_profiles.burst: accept up to four rows then release up to one response/lane/cycle; timeout flush after 16 cycles to avoid waiting for nonexistent small-K requests

steady_measurement.output_stall_profile: ready=0 for first 3 of every 11 cycles; fixed schedule independent of DUT
steady_measurement.same_prng_events: seed/lane/request-ordinal keyed response latencies and fixed-cycle ready sequence; payloads tied to request identity
steady_measurement.window: Measure 1000 intervals after 100 warmup jobs: completion interval from final output accept of job99 to job1099; separately DRAM-service interval from final response of job99 to job1099. Count useful bytes for jobs100..1099 only; finish after job1099. This removes a constant initial pipeline latency.
steady_measurement.rule: For every identical-workload case, both completion and DRAM-service interval cycles must be <= reference; no rounding tolerance. Bytes/job and outputs identical. Report absolute latency separately.
steady_measurement.no_response_backpressure: total reserved outstanding data plus stored-but-unconsumed data must fit true per-lane/row capacity; partial rows retained
steady_measurement.PRNG: Python random.Random seeded by base_seed*1000003+lane*1009+request_ordinal; ready schedule uses separate seed base_seed*1000033+lane; no use of shared RNG consumption by DUT events

physical_qualification: each die completely routed; no shorts/opens; DRC/antenna/LVS pass under installed rules
all used vertical terminals paired and legal under proxy rules
actual connection and SPEF coverage for every cross-die path
setup/hold nonnegative at TT with min/max link envelope and common uncertainty
same-workload supply and compute gates pass
verification.power: same seeded continuous-job gate-netlist VCD, propagate/annotate activity including links; report coverage; integrate full measured window energy/jobs; include endpoint cells and link C once, not twice; no default-activity power claimed as workload result

requires: selected model/framework and explicit internal budget

sensitivity: P0 frozen and primary-best frozen in T12p5
P0 frozen and primary-best frozen in D5
matrix.infeasible_geometry_or_capacity: record not feasible without PnR; do not widen interface or enlarge area
matrix.no_candidate_passes: deliver failure and stop, no forced winner

native_model_token_proposal.authorization: superseded: user removed token caps and requires P0 checkpoint

execution.budget_policy: count all input/output tokens including repeated context; reserve next-call estimate; do not auto-transfer phases or erase failed attempts; model identity and actual allowance supplied by user before phase2; no calls in phase1
execution.end: deliver first-round report and stop; no multi-LB or 3-tier expansion

assumptions: All TSV/pad/RC parameters are research proxies and must be replaceable with real process/stack inputs.
1mm square is the reduced experiment footprint, not the real 13x6.6mm DRAM size.
Geometry capacity is not evidence of routability.
No additional DRAM normal lanes or bandwidth from spare MCs.
Thermal/IR/EM/yield remain unqualified; fixed 25C PPA is conditional.

bank_mapping.kind: assumed logical mapping consistent with V1.1 counts, not vendor physical pin/bank numbering
bank_mapping.rule: for LB ell, MC j=2*t+p serves DRAM tier t and bank rows 2*(ell//5)+b, column 2*(ell%5)+p, b=0,1; spare MC8/9 replace targets without adding workload bandwidth
bank_mapping.spare_physical_location: unknown; retain original symmetric proxy geometry, not a recovered real location
